name: search_catalogue
title: Search the catalogue
description: Search catalogued legal sources by words in their title, citation or cleared full text. Returns metadata, rights status and official links.

query.description: Words to find, such as a title, a citation or a phrase. Case doesn't matter.

limit.description: How many sources to return, 1 to 25.

jurisdiction.description: One jurisdiction to search, such as rw (Rwanda) or ng (Nigeria). Without it, the search covers every jurisdiction available to you.

name: get_source
title: Get one source
description: Get one catalogued source by its ID, including rights status and access mode.

source_id.description: The source's ID, such as ng-foi-act-2011, from a search.

name: get_relationships
title: Get a source's history
description: Whether a source is current and how it relates to other public sources, one step away: what it repeals or amends and the law it is made under, what repealed or amended it, the instruments made under it, and the source in force in its place now when it has been repealed. Only links a reviewer has checked against the official text. A page at a time.

source_id.description: The source's ID, such as ng-isa-2007, from a search.

relation_type.description: Only links of this kind, such as repealed_by or enables.

limit.description: Links per page, 1 to 100. The default is 25.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to continue it.

name: get_anchor
title: Get one part of a text exactly
description: One part of a published text, such as a section or article, exactly: its words, its span as UTF-8 byte offsets, the hash of its bytes for checking a quotation, a citation such as s. 23(1)(a), the official file and the attribution its rights record asks for. Never shortened: a part too large for one answer is refused; read it from the REST text route with its offsets.

anchor_id.description: The part's ID, from a text's structure.

name: list_changes
title: List catalogue changes
description: Changes to the catalogue in commit order: records added, corrected or withdrawn, and text published. Filter by jurisdiction, work, type, document class, language or keyword. Pass the returned resume_token next time to get only newer changes. Changes to what Open Alvary holds, not every change in a country's law.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction IDs, such as ng or rw; a country includes its states.

work.description: Source IDs, to follow particular laws.

type.description: Kinds of change: catalogue_added, metadata_corrected, text_version_published, withdrawal, coverage_changed.

class.description: Document types, such as act or regulation.

language.description: Languages of the affected text, such as en.

q.description: Whole words in the title, citation or summary.

resume_token.description: The resume_token of an earlier answer, for only newer changes.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to continue it.

name: get_change
title: Get one change
description: One catalogue change by its event_id.

name: get_coverage
title: Catalogue coverage
description: Counts of catalogued sources and of sources with openly redistributable full text.
